findings.reason: naming the owner to extend (or a database-keyed chunk property it consumes) is the difference between one linkage and a parallel one, and §3's done-when depends on the edges existing.
findings.text: §3 says the handbook page's chunk "carries a `DOCUMENTS` edge … to every FacilitySignal of the database it fronts" but never names how the edge is written; the existing writer is `link_chunks_to_entities` (`imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:252`), whose `DOCUMENTS` MERGE at line 319 keys off chunk properties `ppf_paths_mentioned`/`mdsplus_paths_mentioned` that no EDAS path sets — so §3 either silently adds a second chunk→signal edge-writer or the edges never exist

findings.reason: §3 and §6 already model the required accounting; §2 should state that the typed slots retire the prototype's `class:T`/`shots:E080000-` keyword parking or why no retirement is possible.
findings.text: the section extends `schemas/facility.yaml` with `data_class`, `shot_range` and `pid` on FacilitySignal (facility.yaml:2240/2246/2251) plus the `SignalDataClass` enum (facility.yaml:102) — public-definition surface — without the "Interface accounting" sentence its siblings §3 and §6 carry, naming no definition it retires or merges

findings.reason: refusal_families is a tracked family this week at 0; the section must say what refusal it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
findings.text: the section's interface accounting covers only the config block; its own done-when adds a refusal ("`discover signals` and `discover code` run that check before a remote scan and refuse when the floor is not met"), a new member of the refusal family (§6 text, plan line 287) — no retirement or merge is named

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §6's `resolve_remote_environment` (`imas_codex/remote/environment.py:62`) hides block-plus-data-system-override precedence behind one function and keeps the executor parameter-only; §2 and §7 add slots and an ordering fix, not new surface spread across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 reuses the existing `DOCUMENTS` relationship but never names the mechanism that writes the chunk→FacilitySignal edges, which has an owner to extend; a second edge-writer would fork it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — §2 adds three FacilitySignal properties and a `SignalDataClass` enum (public_definitions) and §6 adds a preflight refusal to `discover signals`/`discover code`, neither section naming what it retires or merges or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the mechanisms it names and cites their owners: §6 names `imas_codex/remote/python.py` (`get_python_status`, `PythonVersion.meets_minimum`, `MIN_PYTHON`) and `imas_codex/remote/tools.py` (`check_tool`/`check_all_tools`), all present; §3 cites the existing `WikiChunk` `DOCUMENTS` relationship (`documents_signals`, `imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3831`) that `search_tools.py:547` and `:818` already traverse; §7 names `seed_worker` in `imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2360`, where the ordering defect reproduces.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §6 explicitly extends `get_python_status`/`check_all_tools` and adds no CLI command, and §3 reuses the existing `WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal` edge rather than a parallel `DOCUMENTED_IN` edge; both wrappers name why the existing mechanism cannot simply carry the addition.
